observedByAgent.game: Four 3D cases: observe mistake, choose rule, place car, see legal explanation, replay corrected approach/wait/continue. Four full cases completed in the real browser twice; last result4/4. STOP0km/h label observed during waiting; blue correct car and gray mistake ghost visually inspected.
observedByAgent.exam: After deterministic mixing of statement positions, 25 different questions were answered. The first five had one intentionally wrong statement each. Result: 20/25 correct, 5 app-errors, 0 unanswered. Answers, flag and deadline persisted reload; result unchanged after reload. Earlier real 25-minute expiry was also tested.
observedByAgent.mobile: 390×844 and360×800 no horizontal overflow in tested game/feedback views. Loaded correct-position thumbnail,44px+ buttons, no humor in calm setting, static corrected STOP supported. Humor/motion settings persisted reload.
observedByAgent.content: 83 original four-statement questions, 58 sections across 10 chapters, 58 short lessons, 174 cards, 58 cases and 58 self-recalls. Initial legal/text review found 2 P1 and 13 P2 issues across lessons; repaired. A later numbered-heading existence audit found additional wrong references; repaired. The 232 card/case locators now contain only existing numbered plan headings. This does not prove every fact or image flawless, and is not a full curriculum audit.
